profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Mobile | Swift, SwiftUI, C#
profile.summary:
Software Engineer passionate about driving innovation and solving complex challenges through technology. I thrive on collaboration and am always eager to connect with other tech professionals who are passionate about making a difference through technology. Whether you're interested in discussing the latest in tech innovations or exploring potential collaborations, feel free to reach out!

My goals:
- Developing high-performance applications and platforms
- Leading cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget
- Innovating solutions to enhance user experience and operational efficiency
- Implementing best practices in code quality, security, and scalability

Specialties: Software Development, Project Leadership, Innovation, Problem Solving,

Let's innovate and create solutions that matter!

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Mobile
positions.description: As a Principal Software Engineer focusing on innovative mobile solutions for better kitchen design experience using Augmented Reality, spatial computing, and 3D technologies. My work bridges the gap between the physical and digital worlds, delivering user-centric experiences that redefine interaction in spatial spaces. By leveraging cutting-edge AR frameworks and 3D modeling techniques, I build robust and scalable applications that push the boundaries of mobile and AR ecosystems. I am passionate about shaping the future of technology through creativity, collaboration, and impactful results.

positions.title: Lead Innovative Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led numerous proof-of-concept projects that eventually became live products in the Lowe's ecosystem. The main focus area is mobile development, Augmented Reality, and creating tools and apps using Unity. I worked on other projects that tested my creativity and problem-solving. 

My latest delivered project is Measure Your Space 2.0. It uses Apple's RoomPlan to allow users to scan their rooms and build parametric room data. The data is injected and converted into an editable floor plan.

For more comprehensive project details, please visit this link.
https://jiwoonlee.com/lowes-innovation-labs/
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · C# · Swift (Programming Language) · Unity · SwiftUI · iOS · Github Action · Internet of Things (IoT) · Augmented Reality (AR) · Python (Programming Language) · Git

positions.title: Senior iOS & Unity Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Main focus on mobile app and game development.
- Native iOS development and Unity development.
- Collaboration with clients.
- Project Lead for many projects with high visibility.
- Project Lead for Philips Sonicare for Kids app with Bluetooth-connected brushing experience.
- Worked with the Penguin Random House mobile team to update apps and games for iOS9 and iOS10 releases.

Comprehensive Project Details
https://jiwoonlee.com/projects-smashing-ideas/
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Objective-C · C# · iOS · Unity 3D Development · iOS Development

positions.title: Contract Developer
positions.description:
Developed Movo Wave application using Xamarin for the Movo Band. 
Also implemented FSK modulation/demodulation algorithm in C#.
Movo Wave app core was made for both iOS/Android.

positions.title: Mobile/Platform Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on Hawken.
- Worked on Storm Backend Services, a backend platform game service using Web API, .Net, and C#. Design, documentation, implementation, source control, build automation, and agile methodology.
- Worked on Storm SDK, which is a communication library written in C++ that allowed game clients and game servers to communicate with Storm Backend Services.
- Replicated Hawken Mech Garage for a web browser using Unity.
- Created an internal iOS utility app that registered new players offline and generated data for an automated email system.
- Ported Hawken (Unreal Engine 3) to Mac.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Part Time Contract)
positions.description:
This position was part time contract work while I was working full time at Meteor Entertainment. It was prototype project. Created initial prototype of porting Fayve iOS app to android using Unity 3D.

After the prototype was approved for real project, I worked on taking the prototype closer to the production stage. Following issues were resolved.

- 2D User Interface design combined with 3D user elements
- Asynchronous HTTP calls to the Fayve API/Services
- Performance validation
- Training another engineer up to speed with Unity

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
Created iOS 3D puzzle game Master Blaster in Unity3D. In-App purchase, Facebook connection, Twitter connection, Flurry Analytics integration.

Ported console game Frogger (PS3, XBLA, Wii) to iOS and Android for Konami. Redefined control and gameplay redesigned the UI, game content optimization, social networking integration, and Flurry integration.

Created iOS puzzle prototype in Objective C and cocos2d iPhone framework.

positions.title: iPhone Game Programmer
positions.description:
Developed two iOS games using native Objective C and C++.

Develop prototype of the initial game concept.

Implemented all aspects of the game. Physics, user interface, game mechanics, asset building process, and etc.

Work closely with graphic and sound designers to create optimal game assets.

Test driven development.

Make proper tweaks and changes as per user input during alpha and beta stages.

Successfully published two games using Box2d Physics and Cocos2d iPhone Framework.

positions.title: Director of Operations
positions.description:
- Small to Large-scale construction project management. 
- Responsible for planning, communications, preventive, and crisis management.
- Oversee materials, labor, purchasing, shipping & receiving operations, and cash flow.
- Heavy industries project management.
- Over 2,500 man power management.

positions.title: Hardware Design Engineer
positions.description:
- Audio Circuit, Telephone Circuit, and Power Supply Design.
- Microprocessor & Microcontroller System Design
- High Speed Memory, DSP, Digital I/O, PLD, CPLD, and XPGA.
- Printed Circuit Board Design
- Hardware Debugging & Verification
- Sustaining Engineering
- Compliance Engineering
- Universal Test Fixture Hardware & Software Design
- Design & Implementation of firmware in C

projects.title: Sonicare for Kids
projects.description: Worked on many core aspect of the app development. Mostly on initial code design and state machine and later moved to improved interaction of brushing. Also implemented BLE library integration on unity side and on the native iOS side. Lastly, spent good amount of time on improving UI.

projects.title: Hawkings App
projects.description: Assisted several bug fixes and also added In app purchasing on the app.
